claims.text: Refining a tungsten-based RHEA to a nanocrystalline microstructure will increase its room-temperature yield strength relative to its coarse-grained state.
Refining a tungsten-based RHEA to a nanocrystalline microstructure will improve its room-temperature ductility relative to its coarse-grained state.
The nanocrystalline tungsten-based RHEA will retain high-temperature stability comparable to that of the coarse-grained state.
The nanocrystalline tungsten-based RHEA will retain irradiation resistance comparable to that of the coarse-grained state.
The conventional coarse-grained tungsten-based RHEA baseline is already known to have good high-temperature and irradiation stability.
High-energy ball milling followed by severe plastic deformation, or equivalent thermomechanical processing, can produce the proposed nanocrystalline structure in the target RHEA.
The proposed performance and stability should persist at temperatures up to approximately 1100 °C.
A nanocrystalline WTaCrVHf RHEA can resist heavy-ion irradiation, dual-beam irradiation, and helium implantation with low defect evolution and no detectable grain growth.
Nanocrystalline grain refinement increases grain-boundary density.
The increased grain-boundary density provides sinks for irradiation-induced defects.
The refined grain structure aids dislocation-mediated deformation.
Grain refinement increases yield strength through the Hall-Petch effect.
Enhanced grain-boundary-mediated plasticity can improve ductility in the nanocrystalline RHEA.
Grain boundaries promote recombination of irradiation-induced point defects and thereby maintain irradiation stability.
Nanometre-grained refractory HEA pillars can reach approximately 10 GPa yield strength and more than 30% compressive plastic strain, substantially outperforming bulk material at small scales.
Mechanical improvements observed in microscale specimens may not translate directly to bulk material.
Extreme irradiation doses or prolonged exposure could destabilize the nanocrystalline structure.
